scope: V4-2 role contracts, code supervisor, provider registry and HPD provider baseline

agentBoundaries.main: intent, room scope, Skill selection and clarification only
agentBoundaries.structure: wall, opening, room and dimension candidate selection plus bounded measurement
agentBoundaries.vision: furniture object-candidate classification, orientation and activity groups only
agentBoundaries.design: frozen symbol-to-catalogue matching and preflight only
agentBoundaries.check: structured issue reporting against the current draft hash
agentBoundaries.coordinator: fixed-code stage, budget, permissions, issue ownership and stop/repair routing

verified: Each Agent receives an allowlisted RoleContextV1 and emits a hash-bound StageResultV1.
The review coordinator maps issue codes to structure, vision, assets, design or coordinator.
A missing evidence reference cannot trigger a model repair loop.
The HPD provider runs in a subprocess and returns a hashed ArtifactEnvelopeV1.
The provider process has no evaluation reference input and its file guard reports zero forbidden accesses.
The provider declares no room or furniture capability.
The capabilities API exposes V4-2 as experimental and photo inputs as reserved.
V1/V2/V3 and V4-1 task snapshots remain separate.
notClaimed: second image or full S2 acceptance
